title: Gas Safe Register UK Business Search

location.title: Town or postcode
location.description: One UK town or postcode. If a town is ambiguous, enter Town, County (for example, London, Middlesex).

maxResults.title: Maximum unique businesses
maxResults.description: Maximum unique businesses to return, deduplicated by registration number. The Actor automatically reads enough listing pages (about 10 businesses per page) to reach this count, up to 250.

includeEngineers.title: Include engineers
includeEngineers.description: Collect public engineer names, status and contact details.

includeQualifications.title: Include qualifications
includeQualifications.description: Collect Natural gas, LPG and Building regulations qualifications. Requires Include engineers.
